changelog:
Initial release of WeChat Group Jielong (接龙) parsing skill.

- Supports parsing of WeChat group jielong (group order) text to extract product lists and detailed participant order records.
- Identifies products by parsing both full names and price lines, using keyword fingerprinting for robust product nickname matching.
- Handles common order line complexities: nicknames, room numbers, product abbreviations, multiple products/quantities per line, and default product rules.
- Outputs a participant-by-row pivot table including per-product columns, order totals, and proper handling of edge cases (e.g., only one product, duplicate orders, ambiguous nicknames).
- Integrates with Tencent Docs: automatically writes detailed order and summary sheets when the tencent-docs connector is available, and returns document links.
- Provides error-tolerant matching for typos, disambiguation hints, and clear marking for closed (截单) items and special notes.
summary: 解析微信群接龙文本，提取商品清单与订单明细，按用户订单生成透视表并支持腾讯文档导出。
